public.text: There are emerging challenges about long term archiving, reference and review of digital health records (all components but for the sake of this comment principally the individual direct clinical records)
public.suggestedRevision:
Documents versus machine readable data and applications to present primary data with the necessary supporting registry of systems/versions, archived digital applications etc etc are all needed.
Non-standard approach would be to treat documents and the data separately but require both: one as static, validated images of a "transaction" the other as the persistent logical representation of an individual (events, trajectory etc). This is not data embedded documents but loosely analogous to double entry book keeping
